Plot one library service against Victoria over time

Source: R/plot_visits.R
plot_visits.Rd

Draws a line chart of library visits per resident for the chosen library service (blue) and for Victoria as a whole (grey, dashed) from 2022-23 to 2024-25. Years with no reported data are not drawn, so a service with only one reported year appears as a single point.

Usage

plot_visits(service)

Arguments

service

Name of a library service in library_visits, for example "Yarra".

Value

A ggplot object.

Examples

plot_visits("Yarra")
